title: Coven Automations v1 shared definitions
description: Shared value definitions for coven.automations.v1. Schemas in this directory reference these via relative $ref. Unknown-field rule: v1 objects set additionalProperties=false and carry optional data only through the explicit extensionBag.

automationId.description: Stable automation identifier; charset and bound match the #816 definition validator.

adoptionKey.description: Stable request/adoption (idempotency) key supplied by the caller. Replays of the same command with the same key return the first committed outcome unchanged.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC, millisecond precision, matching the #816 store encoding (chrono SecondsFormat::Millis).

value.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical serialization of the covered object.

fenceToken.description: Monotonic per-occurrence generation. Incremented on every accepted claim; a fence token owns at most one accepted run.

principalId.description: Canonical principal identifier from the authority layer. This protocol binds but does not define principal semantics.

familiarId.description: Exact familiar identity binding; resolved and owned by the familiar identity layer.

capabilities.description: Capability requirement keys the run depends on; advertised by the runtime descriptor layer.

approvalPolicyRef.description: Reference into the authority/approval policy layer; this protocol records the binding, never the decision.

additionalProperties.$comment: Extension values are opaque JSON; producers must keep them small and consumers must preserve but never interpret them until understood.

propertyNames.description: Keys are either x-prefixed (vendor-local) or reverse-DNS namespaced (example com.acme.lift). Untyped keys are rejected.

extensionBag.description: Explicit extension bag. Extensions are preserved on round-trip, never required, never influence state, digests, or authorization until they are promoted into a new contract profile.

misfireDisposition.description: How planning disposed of this slot relative to the misfire policy. collapsed_to_latest is the #816 misfire-latest semantic.

instanceId.description: Stable instance identifier of the producer.

implementationVersion.description: Release version of the producing implementation. Never confused with the contract profile.

importedFrom.description: Legacy source marker for imported definitions, for example codex.automation.toml.

activationWindow.description: Optional activation window. Outside the window the definition behaves as paused without changing lifecycle state.
